items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2027
items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 35-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.
Each competitor in blindfolded events will have a 3-hour cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 35 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.
Každý soutěžící v disciplínách poslepu má k dispozici 3 hodiny, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.name: Bolivia Nationals 2026
items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩

Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing.

Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial.

La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!**   🟥🟨🟩
His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special.

We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship.

Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MDQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c0d143d39819bad425907a01d1201cca236592fa/BN26%20-%20WCA%20-%20%20Banner.png)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMDUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb89206b5263dbd95b0c2c4f82523a97b1aff0d5/home%20wca%20ic%2026.png)


# Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum.

Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut.

**Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.**

**Catatan Penting:**
Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama)

Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
* **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori
* **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
* **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3

Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung.

Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag.

Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event.

Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran.

-----------------------

# Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public.

All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition.

All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified.

**On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.**

**Important Notes:**
There are competitor limits for the following events:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors)

There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition:
* **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event
* **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality
* **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event

By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event.

All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag.

Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event.

Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days.

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!

Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

**English:**
We are happy to announce the first ever Austrian Nationals!

The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει!

Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές.

Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. 

Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back!

On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments.

Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process.

Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration!

Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

### Registration Reminders

See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. items.name: Trondheim Høst 2026
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 175kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med.

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration

### Outside Food not permitted###
This venue does **not** allow anyone to bring outside food or drinks in. Bringing in water is allowed. The venue's concession will be open. We apologize for the inconvenience and we thank you for your cooperation.

**Registration Reminders**
You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. **Unpaid registrations will not be accepted**. 
​
Since this is a "favourites" competition, you may choose **at most five (5) events**.
​
Please review all of the tabs listed on this website. Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.
​
Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before September 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST.

items.information:
**Español**

Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango.

Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica.

Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes.

Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes.

Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13.

¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026!


**English**

This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango.

Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica.

Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant.

This competition will take place at two different venues.

Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th.

Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026!

items.information:
**Bem-vindos ao segundo campeonato no Sudoeste do Paraná!**
​
🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [Guia para competidores novatos](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing).
​
Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. Competidores participando pela primeira vez devem apresentar um documento oficial que contenha foto, nome completo, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.
​
Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes da competição.
​
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral na primeira rodada).
​
Após o término do prazo das inscrições, serão aceitas inscrições no local do campeonato apenas na modalidade 3x3x3, no valor de R$ 35,00. O Competidor deverá chegar com 30 minutos de antecedência e a inscrição só será aceita caso ainda haja vagas.

---
​
**Welcome to the second competition in the Southwest of the state of Paraná!**
​
🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, read this [Guide for newcomers](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing).
​
All competitors must present a valid photo ID at the check-in. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document containing a photo, full name, date of birth, and nationality.
​
Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
​
There will be awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for female competitors and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will be based on the ranking of the first round).
​
After the registration period ends, registrations will be accepted at the competition venue only for the 3x3x3 event, for BRL 35.00. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes in advance and registration will only be accepted if there are still registration slots available.
​

This is the New York state championship for big cubes (5x5, 6x6, and 7x7) and quiet events (3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blind)! This competition is open to everyone, but only New York residents are eligible for New York champion titles - see the Championship Eligibility tab for more info.

There are **separate registration limits** for each event. Out of courtesy for other competitors, please only register for events that you actually plan to compete in. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 60 hasn't been reached.

4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD: 30 competitors each
5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3BLD, FMC: 40 competitors each

Please avoid bringing unnecessary guests, especially on Days 2 and 3, to help the competition stay quiet.
The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.
**ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores!

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.
**ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish!

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**

**Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.**

**Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region.

**Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026.

**Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1NDY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1a80b3093d41365b7c54afc7359d382cbeed9e5a/CaminosSalamanca.jpeg)
**ESPAÑOL**
***🎵"Ojalá que te vaya bonito, ojalá que se acaben tus penas, que te digan que yo ya no existo, y conozcas personas más buenas..."🎶***

## Caminos de Guanajuato – Salamanca, Guanajuato 2026

La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** continúa su recorrido y hace escala en **Salamanca, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Esta competencia forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo.
En cada parada, la música de *José Alfredo Jiménez* acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Salamanca.

El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música.

Te esperamos en Salamanca para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**ENGLISH**
***🎵"Ojalá que te vaya bonito, ojalá que se acaben tus penas, que te digan que yo ya no existo, y conozcas personas más buenas..."🎶***

The **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** route continues its journey and makes a stop in **Salamanca, Guanajuato**, a city that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and everyday life come together in every corner. This competition is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing, but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different host cities through a shared spirit of competition and celebration.
At each stop along the way, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have become an essential expression of the spirit and emotions of the people of Guanajuato, inspire this edition dedicated to Salamanca.

The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music.

We look forward to seeing you in Salamanca to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

Deutsch:
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

English:
We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyODYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1e4894d78da01f540cf034021bf4d9bf981e69c8/nm2026.jpeg)

## 🇳🇴 (NB) Informasjon
Velkommen til norgesmesterskapet i kubing 2026, denne gangen tilbake i Trondheim. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er hjertelig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen]
(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

---

## 🇳🇴 (NN) Informasjon
Velkomen til noregsmeisterskapen i kubing, som er tilbake i Trondheim i år. Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegongsdeltakarar
Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

##CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Championship 2026!

**Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. 

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

For information regarding FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD, please refer to the [FMC/BLIND](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#67514-fmc-blind) tab.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#62666-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips.

---

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) and follow CubingBC on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/p/Cubingbc-61569731858139/) or [Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/cubingbc/)

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

### Hawaii's first ever state championship is here!

All competitors are welcome to attend and compete. Only Hawaiian residents will be eligible for the title of Hawaii State Champion. More information can be found on the [State Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HawaiiChampionship2026#67164-state-champion-eligibility) tab.

---

##### Different days will have different events. The following days will hold the following events:
* Friday: 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 MultiBlind
* Saturday: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb
* Sunday: 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face Turning Octahedron

**You are not required to be present on days you will not be competing.**

---

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial on Saturday at 9:00 AM.

items.name: Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026!

Sveriges sista tävling innan Europeiska Mästerskapet i Nederländerna!
Första tävlingen någonsin som erbjuder övernattning i vindskydd!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026!

Sweden's last competition before the European Championships in the Netherlands!
First competition ever to offer overnight stays in outdoor wind shelters!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

**Important Information for Participants:**

### Welcome to Philippine Championship 2026!

The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) proudly presents the 15th World Cube Association National Championship for the **Philippines**, the annual culmination of the best Filipino speedcubers in their respective events. This competition brings together the nation's top talents for an exciting showcase of skill, determination, and sportsmanship.

Only the **top three** winners representing the **Philippines** of each category will receive physical awards such as medals and plaques.
The top three winners of any Finals, regardless of nationality, will be recognized together with the top three at the awarding ceremony.

Looking for 3x3 Fewest Moves? Check out [Philippine FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026).

## ABOUT THIS EVENT

This competition will be the highest from ground level ever held in the World. This claim derives from our own research and is not an official measure from the WCA as the WCA does not track elevation or altitude as an official statistic.
The competition will be held on the 45th floor of the hotel at 189m from ground level.

items.information:
**Special Notice**
[**FMC World 2026 - Guangzhou**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026) will be held on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 8:00 to 12:00 in the Meeting Room of Conghua Argyle Hotel (No. 514 Guangcong South Road), Guangzhou. This event is a simultaneous FMC competition for fewest moves enthusiasts worldwide. In addition to the official global top three awards, the Guangzhou Site will present separate awards to its top three competitors.

June 21, 2026 coincides with the summer solstice; at noon, the sun will directly shine on the Tropic of Cancer (23°26′N). After the morning fewest moves competition finishes, we cordially invite all competitors to gather at the nearby Guangzhou Tropic of Cancer Park. An award ceremony will be held in front of the Tropic of Cancer Memorial Tower, where competitors will jointly stack a tower column with Rubik's Cubes, witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of "an upright pole casting no shadow."

Event page:
https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026

Registration process:
First, complete registration via the event page above (WCA account login required). 
Then, pay the registration fee using Alipay to the Guangzhou Cubing account (gzcubeteam@gmail.com). 
Upon successful payment, registration will be confirmed. 
For any questions regarding registration or payment, please contact the organizer via email (same address as above), 
or search for the WeChat public account "动物魔友会Animal Cubing" and reach out to customer service within the public account.


**About the Awards**
1) This competition only has the special-shaped puzzles speed-solving event. In addition to the awards for the top three in each event, awards will also be given to the first place in the competition in the sum of rankings of all events. If there is a tie in the total ranking, the better ranking of Pyraminx will be given priority based on most registration.
2) Competitors must accept any certificates, awards, or prizes in person. Competitors that do not appear in person will forfeit any prizes.
3) The main event of this event is the Pyraminx, and the first place in this event will be announced as the champion of this competition, with the best prizes.


**Accompanying Persons and Spectators**
To ensure a quiet and orderly competition environment, each competitor may bring a maximum of 1 accompanying person for free admission. Any additional accompanying persons must purchase an admission ticket on-site at the price of ¥50 per person per day. All accompanying persons must register together with the contestant. 


**Friendly Reminder**
This competition does not have any official competitor chat groups. Please be mindful of protecting your personal information and property.
If you have any questions, please email the organizers at gzcubeteam@gmail.com, or search for our official account "动物魔友会" (Animal Cubing) on WeChat and contact customer service through the account.

## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2026!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF for dere som gir oss beskjed om det. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2026!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. 

If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members who inform us about their membership. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.name: Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!**

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

**OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7.

**OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten.

-----

Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

**NOTE:** The 6x6x6, 7x7x7 and Megaminx events **can not** be combined with the 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD events. This means that, for example, you **can not** enter both Megaminx and 3x3x3 BLD, but you can enter both Megaminx and 7x7x7.

**NOTE:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed.

items.name: Franconia Cube Days 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1ODE1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5b97380e04dc31adffc60a72bbfc202cab42c5f/FCD.jpg)
###Liebe Speedcuber/innen,
Wir laden Euch herzlich zu den Franconia Cube Days 2026 ein. Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch.

###Dear competitors,
Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

**Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/).

Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

**6x6 and Square-1:**
There will be no cutoff for 6x6 or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 6x6 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results.

**Draw prizes:** 
There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Notice of Filming and Photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: CuBonn Open 2026
items.information:
Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn!
Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben.

Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert!

Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird.
Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen!

Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn!
For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together.

Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate!

Be part of Bonn’s very first tournament and help us make it legendary.
Sign up now – we can’t wait to see you there!

## 경상남도에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--580e15233f5c8e3065f8116ca9163a7eba4d3743/Picture1.png)
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70113-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70112-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
## First WCA competition in Gyeongsangnam-do Province!

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70113-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70112-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: Örebro Side Events 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events!

Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [**Cubing Contests**](https://cubingcontests.com). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to the third edition of Örebro Side Events!

Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

This competition will also include Unofficial Events, rules and results can be found at **[Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com)**. Read more under the tab Unofficial Events.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png)

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026.

El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026.

UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

# **CubiKonce 2026**
​
## **Español**
​
¡Se celebra en Concepción la novena edición de la competición **"CubiKonce"**, en esta ocasión llamada **"CubiKonce 2026"**! 
​
✨ **¡Los esperamos con ansias en esta competición!**  
🍀 **¡Buena suerte, amigos cuberos!**
​
No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de esta emocionante competición. **¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades cuberas y disfrutar de un día lleno de diversión!**
​
**¡Nos vemos en Concepción!**

---
​
## **English**
​
The nineth edition of the **'CubiKonce'** competition is taking place in Concepción, this time named **'CubiKonce 2026.'** 
​
✨ **We eagerly await your participation in this competition.**  
🍀 **Good luck, cube enthusiast friends!**
​
Don't miss the opportunity to be part of this thrilling competition. **Get ready to challenge your cubing skills and enjoy a day filled with fun!**
​
**See you in Concepción!**

​
##### Español
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

¡Bienvenidos a **555 - Puebla 2026**!

Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tu nivel.

**¿Estás listo para el desafío del 5x5?**

El nombre del torneo no es coincidencia. El 5x5 representa un reto que exige estrategia, precisión y concentración.

Así, el 5x5 se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes.

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 **555 - Puebla 2026** es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​
AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

##### English
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome to **555 - Puebla 2026**!

Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will test your level.

**Are you ready for the 5x5 challenge?**

The name of the tournament is no coincidence. The 5x5 represents a challenge that requires strategy, precision, and focus.

That’s why 5x5 becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging events.

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 **555 - Puebla 2026** is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4cb58b9882a96f08b772fdbe40b22da459dd42c3/amcm_lateral.png)
### 🇧🇷 Português
Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira!
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

# **VAQUITA MORELIA 2026**
**Español**
Ven y cubea con nosotros en la hermosa ciudad de la cantera rosada Morelia , Michoacan; un torneo pequeño pero con grandes animos para seguir creciendo nuestra hermosa comunidad.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA]
(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**English**
Come and enjoy cubing with us in the beautiful pink quarry city of Morelia, Michoacán; a small competition with great enthusiasm to keep growing our wonderful community.
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.
Come and cube with us in the beautiful city of Morelia, Michoacan, known for its pink quarry stone. It's a small tournament, but with great enthusiasm to continue growing our wonderful community.
**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: German Open 2026
items.information:
In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2026 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun!

Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2026 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 45-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 45 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

**Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh**

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các đơn vị truyền thông có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Khi có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________

**Notice on photography and filming**
The organizers and/or media organizations may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises,  **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises.

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Bergen Spring. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese  [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenSpring2026#68177-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Bergen Fall! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

### New Competitors
There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenSpring2026#68177-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады.
Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет.
АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін.
Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады.
Жарыс  Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары  холлда өтеді.
Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды.
Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз

English:
The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia.
Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery.
The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device.
The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment.
The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall.
Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life.
We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.

# 9년 만에 열리는 제주 대회!
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# The first WCA competition in Jeju since 2017!
If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitorshttps://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUyOTEwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--877644a41183eb36ea36c16365d80bcac18bc07d/Halcones.png)
# **¡Halcones Tehuacán 2026!**
**Español**
¡Tehuacán vuelve a alzar el vuelo!
Tras 8 años, y de la mano de la **Preparatoria Federal por Cooperación Gilberto Martínez Gutiérrez**, el desafío del Cubo Rubik regresa a la cuna del maíz, donde la velocidad, estrategia y visión de halcón se ponen a prueba.

Halcones Tehuacán 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**English**
Tehuacán takes flight once again!
After 8 years, and with the support of the **Preparatoria Federal Gilberto Martínez Gutiérrez**, the Rubik’s Cube challenge returns to the cradle of maize, where speed, strategy, and hawk-like vision are put to the test.

Halcones Tehuacán 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).


NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

🇧🇷 **(Português) Brasileiro:**
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8).


❗️**IMPORTANTE**
Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente)


💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵
Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro)

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.


🇬🇧 **English:**
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t).


❗️❗️**IMPORTANT**
This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page.


💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵
In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page.


If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.
